transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function using explicit `slice: &mut [MaybeUninit<T>]` and `src: &[T]` parameters plus the generated ensures clauses. The public target is not external_body and contains no assume_specification.
Preserved the Rust 1.96 length assertion and `let len = self.len(); let src = &src[..len];` equal-length source-prefix step through the harness-local `rust_1_96_equal_len_source_prefix` boundary.

Preserved the Guard initialization counter, length-indexed clone/write loop, `guard.initialized += 1`, and final `forget(guard)` control flow. The harness narrows the per-iteration `guard.slice[i].write(src[i].clone())` operation to `rust_1_96_clone_write_at` because Verus does not model MaybeUninit slot initialization, unchecked slice indexing/provenance, or arbitrary Clone effects directly.

Reused the audited MaybeUninit relation vocabulary and the ordered `core::slice::assume_init_mut` dependency shape for the final initialized-storage cast. Proof-only loop invariants and the named loop-effect bridge expose the generated MaybeUninit written-from relation without changing executable control flow.
